sources.name: OpenStreetMap extracts of the Americas via Geofabrik
sources.url: https://download.geofabrik.de/ (south-america, central-america, north-america/canada, north-america/mexico, north-america/us-pacific, north-america/us-west, north-america/us-midwest, north-america/us-south, north-america/us-northeast)
sources.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors; extracts provided by Geofabrik
sources.use: Every mapped railway alignment, named station, and named place from cities to farms in South, Central and North America: the playable network from Punta Arenas to Wales, Alaska
sources.transformation: scripts/world/fetch-osm-regions.cjs (region by region, filtered to railways, stations and places, then merged), then the rail, station and place extractors with --scope americas: yard, siding and crossover tracks dropped and lines simplified to about 30 m

sources.name: OpenStreetMap extracts of Europe, Asia, Russia and Africa via Geofabrik
sources.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors; extracts provided by Geofabrik
sources.use: Every mapped railway alignment, named station, and named place from cities to farms in Europe, Asia and Africa: the playable network from Wales, Alaska across the Bering Strait tunnel to Cape Town
sources.transformation: scripts/world/fetch-osm-regions.cjs (region by region, filtered to railways, stations and places, then merged), then the rail, station and place extractors with --scope afro-eurasia: yard, siding and crossover tracks dropped, lines simplified to about 30 m, and names given in the Latin alphabet (scripts/world/names.cjs: the local name where it is Latin, else name:en, int_name or an official romanisation, else a transliteration by any-ascii)
